title: 第23章 杰克霜精第24章 更新后的系统
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
当蓝色的光柱冲天而起，法伦的身影在光柱中若隐若现，他手中的左轮仿佛成为了连接现实与异界的桥梁。
突然，光柱中传来了一阵强烈的寒气，空气中的温度骤然下降，离得近的同学感觉呼出的气息都变成了白色的雾气。
紧接着，一道身影在光柱中逐渐显现。
那是一个像雪人一样的小家伙，身高只到普通人的腰部左右，穿着蓝色的小靴子，带着一个蓝色的类似于宫廷小丑的帽子，帽子上画着一个显眼的黄色笑脸。
只见他小手摸着嘴巴，似乎对周围一切都很好奇的模样。
光柱逐渐消失，法伦的身影也露了出来。
“没想到会是杰克霜精。”
其实法伦在一开始多少都能感觉得到，左轮、五维属性这些要素很难不让人联想到，那个有名的RPG游戏——《女神异闻录》。
原着游戏里其实也缝合了不少女神异闻录中的仲魔，但是法伦倒是没想过自己居然会把正主给召唤出来。
“居然是没有见过的召唤兽，这是妖精种？”
伊莎贝拉有些好奇地打量着杰克霜精，眼神里充满了探究和疑惑。
召唤兽之间也有不同的种属，例如妮可的电雷猫就属于野兽种，凯撒的黑龙尼德霍格属于幻想种等等。
对于召唤师来说，召唤出未知的召唤兽并不是什么特别稀奇的事，毕竟这个世界还有很多地方等待探索。
但经过多年的召唤术发展，如今新出现的未知召唤兽通常都是独一无二的存在。
这些召唤兽往往拥有独特的名称，例如凯撒的黑龙尼德霍格和索菲娅的圣洁白龙等。
在人群中，凯撒的脸色变得阴沉。
他看着法伦和那个奇怪的妖精种召唤兽，心中涌起了一股莫名的不爽。
凯撒本以为自己召唤出的幻兽种黑龙尼德霍格已经足够特别与强大，但法伦召唤出的妖精种杰克霜精显然同样不容小觑。
“杰克霜精。”
法伦轻声呼唤道。

听到主人的声音，杰克霜精立刻兴奋起来，发出欢快的叫声：“Hee-ho！”
他迫不及待地跑到法伦身边，紧紧抱住他的大腿，仿佛找到了最温暖的港湾。
随着光柱的消散，训练场上的寒气开始慢慢退去，但杰克霜精的出现已经让所有人感受到了他独特的魔力。
这个小家伙的每一个动作都透露出一股子顽皮和活泼，虽然仍抱着法伦的腿，但他那双漆黑的大眼珠子依旧好奇地打量着周围的世界，似乎对一切都充满了新鲜感。
法伦轻轻地抚摸着杰克霜精的头，感受着他身上传来的冰凉触感。
他能感觉到这个小家伙体内蕴含的强大魔力，以及一种难以言喻的亲切感。
“真是个可爱的小家伙。”
妮可忍不住赞叹道，虽然她仍抱着自己的电雷猫，但仍被杰克霜精的模样吸引，忍不住想要靠近一些，好好看看这个新奇的召唤兽。
千代也露出了微笑，她对法伦说：“看来你这次召唤的结果，比很多人都要特别。”
伊莎贝拉老师则更加关注杰克霜精的潜力和能力，她知道，每一个未知的召唤兽都可能带来新的战术和战斗方式。
“法伦，你要好好了解你的召唤兽，它的能力可能会让你在战斗中获得意想不到的优势。”
content_en:
When the blue light beam soared into the sky, Fallon's figure loomed in the light beam, and the revolver in his hand seemed to become a bridge connecting reality and the other world.
Suddenly, a strong chill came from the light beam, and the temperature in the air dropped suddenly. Students who were close felt that their breath turned into white mist.
Immediately afterwards, a figure gradually appeared in the light pillar.
It was a little guy like a snowman, only about the waist of an ordinary person, wearing blue boots and a blue hat similar to that of a court jester, with a conspicuous yellow smiley face painted on the hat.
I saw his little hand touching his mouth, as if he was curious about everything around him.
The light beam gradually disappeared, and Fallon's figure was revealed.
"I didn't expect it to be Jack Frost."
In fact, Fallon could feel it to some extent at the beginning. Elements such as the revolver and the five-dimensional attributes are hard not to remind people of the famous RPG game - "Persona".
In fact, many Nakama from Persona were stitched together in the original game, but Fallon never thought that he would actually summon the main character.
"It's actually a summoned beast I've never seen before. Is it a fairy species?"
Isabella looked at Jack Frost with some curiosity, her eyes full of inquiry and doubt.
There are also different species among summoned beasts. For example, Nicole's electric thunder cat belongs to the beast species, Caesar's black dragon Nidhogg belongs to the fantasy species, and so on.
For summoners, summoning unknown summoned beasts is not particularly unusual. After all, there are still many places in this world waiting to be explored.
But after years of development of summoning techniques, the new unknown summoned beasts that appear today are usually unique beings.
These summoned beasts often have unique names, such as Caesar's black dragon Nidhogg and Sophia's holy white dragon.
In the crowd, Caesar's face darkened.
He looked at Fallon and the strange elf summoned beast, and felt an inexplicable discomfort in his heart.
Caesar thought that the black dragon Nidhogg of the phantom beast species he summoned was special and powerful enough, but the Jack Frost spirit of the fairy species summoned by Fallon was obviously not to be underestimated.
"Jack Frost."
Fallon called softly.
Hearing his master's voice, Jack Frost immediately became excited and shouted cheerfully: "Hee-ho!"
He couldn't wait to run to Fallon and hugged his thigh tightly, as if he had found the warmest harbor.
As the light beam dissipated, the cold air on the training ground began to slowly recede, but the appearance of Jack Frost already made everyone feel his unique magic.
Every movement of this little guy revealed a sense of naughtiness and liveliness. Although he was still holding Fallon's legs, his big dark eyes were still curiously looking at the world around him, and he seemed to be full of freshness about everything.
Fallon gently stroked Jack Frost's head, feeling the cold touch coming from him.
He could feel the powerful magic contained in this little guy's body, as well as an indescribable sense of intimacy.
"What a cute little guy."
Nicole couldn't help but admired. Although she was still holding her electric thunder cat, she was still attracted by the appearance of Jack Frost. She couldn't help but want to get closer to take a good look at this novel summoned beast.
Chiyo also smiled and said to Fallon: "It seems that the result of your summons is more special than many others."
Teacher Isabella is more concerned about the potential and ability of Jack Frost. She knows that every unknown summoned beast may bring new tactics and fighting methods.
"Falun, you need to know your summoned beast well. Its abilities may give you unexpected advantages in battle."
